test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.**

Granny had given Uncle Ken a good lecture on how to be a responsible adult.

options.text: Uncle Ken was giving a good lecture to Granny on how to be a responsible adult.
Granny was given a good lecture by Uncle Ken on how to be a responsible adult.
Uncle Ken was being given a good lecture by Granny on how to be a responsible adult.
Uncle Ken had been given a good lecture by Granny on how to be a responsible adult.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Uncle Ken had been given a good lecture by Granny on how to be a responsible adult.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the active voice of past perfect tense.
 
• Past perfect tense: The past perfect, also called the pluperfect, is a verb tense used to talk about actions that were completed before some point in the past.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• (Active voice) Subject+ had+ the third form of verb+ object
 
• (Passive voice) Object+ had+been+ the third form of verb+ by subject.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• She had written a letter. (Active voice)
 
 
• Here, the subject is 'she', the object is 'letter' and the main verb is 'wrote' which is the second form of the verb 'write'. To convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject and object will change their places and will be connected with a linking verb followed by the third form of the main verb.
 
 
 
• A letter had been written by her. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Thus, in the above-given sentence, the subject of the sentence i.e. 'Granny' will exchange its place with the object of the sentence i.e. 'Uncle Ken', and will be connected with the linking verb and the third form of the main verb.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *Uncle Ken had been given a good lecture by Granny on how to be a responsible adult.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Subject: a person or thing that is being discussed, described, or dealt with.
 
• Object: a person or thing to which a specified action or feeling is directed.
